༄༅/ /dmar nag 'jigs gsum las bzhi'i gtor ma bsdus pa nyin gcig rdzogs pa'i dbu bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dmar nag 'jigs gsum las bzhi'i gtor ma bsdus pa nyin gcig rdzogs pa'i dbu bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang rgyu 'bras gshin rje kun/ / 'joms byed bde stong dbyer med gshed/ /dngos po kun kyis gus btud nas/ /de yi gtor ma'i rnam dbye bshad/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma bsdus pa gtong bar 'dod pas/ bshams bkod rnams tshar ba dang*/ 'di'i bshams bkod ni/ bris sku la sogs rten gyi mdun du/ yi dam gyi gtor ma zlum gtor zhig stegs mtho ba la bzhag /de'i mdun nam/ g.yon du stegs dma' ba la/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gtor ma zur gsum pa dang*/ snod cung zad yangs pa zhig tu/ phyogs skyong spyi'i gtor ma zlum po'i grub gsum gang 'os bshams/ de rnams kyi mdun du 'theb skyu yang zlum po'am/ gru gsum sogs las gang byed dang bstun/ snod bzhir 'theb skyu bcu drug bcu drug gi snod brgyad du brgyad dam/ bcu drug tu bzhi bzhi bshams pa'am/ yang na snod che ba gcig tu tshan pa so sor bcad de bshams kyang rung*/ de dag gi mdun du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchod pa dang bstun/ de'i mdun du las gshin gyi mchod pa thams cad kyang phyi rol tu spy-i'i mchod pa bshams/ drag po'i las cung zad 'brel na/ rakta'i arghaṃ yang bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang gtor ma byin rlabs thams cad lhan cig tu byas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum gang rung gi bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus lung skabs dang sbyar/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mdun bskyed nyen yod na de la dmigs shing*/ med na mdun gyi nam mkha' bskyed pa yin la/ 'jigs byed lta bu la dper mtshon na/ ya mānta ka sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum zhes pa nas/ mdun bskyed rgyas bsdus dmar nag 'jigs gsum rang rang gi lugs ltar bya/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dbang bskur rgyas gdab rang rang gi lugs ltar bya/

mdun bskyed mchod bstod rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bya/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer gyis rtse mo nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bkug par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣtī bi kri ta nan hūṃ phaṭa/ ind+ra ya sa pa ri wa ra ṇa a karṣa ya dzaḥ sogs nas phur gdab dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ de nas las gshin gyi gtor ma rgyas bsdus gang rung 'bul/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i ched du bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas chos skyong gang mos kyi gtor ma bsngo ba mkha' 'gro sbyi gtor gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs skabs 'dir bya/ drug cu rtsa bzhi btab pa'i tshul ni/ snod so sor na chu dang chang phal pa thog ma nas blug /gtor ma byin rlabs kyi gong du nang mchod re blug oṃ aḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ sa lan gsum byin gyis rlabs/ yi dam gyi snying po tshar re dang phyogs skyong kyi sngags kyi phul/ ind+ra ya= sogs/ phreṃ phreṃ phreṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ bdag dang che ge mo'i sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ oṃ sha dig lāo ka pa la sa pa ri wa ra bhyaḥ zhes mgo bor sbyar la/ arghaṃ= nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ / zhes pas bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab bsdus pa'i skabs/ 'di zhes bya ba'i 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod 'phel/ /thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ /log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /don dam dbyings su tshar chod la/ /zhi ba chen por mdzad du gsol/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pa yan chod zhi ba'i lugs la 'theb skyu zlum po/ rgyas pa la gru bzhi/ dbang la zla gam/ bsad bskrad la gru gsum gong bzhin du sngags dang 'dod don gsol gdab 'dra ba la/

mjug tu rgyas la / tshe dang bsod nams puṣtaṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ dbang la/ che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ dgug pa la/ che ge mo a karṣa ya dza hri/ bskrad pa la/ che ge mo u tsi ṭa ya phaṭa/ bzlog pa la/ byad ma dgra bgegs thams cad ni bā ra ya phaṭa/ bsad pa la/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ rengs pa la/ stambha ya laṃ/ dbye ba la/ che ge mo dang che ge mo bi de sha ya phaṭa/ bsrung ba la/ rakṣa rakṣa sāhā/ zhes spel tshig dang 'don pa sbyar ba bya/ bzhi tshar bcug pa la 'byung po thams cad pa dang lhan cig tu byin pa la/ phyogs skyong gi tshar bzhi dang*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs lan gnyis kyis gtor ma byin nas 'phrin las bcol ba la sogs sngar bzhin du bya/ de nas gtor ma rnams la dpal 'bar btsug la/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ / sogs phyogs skyong gi bstod pa sogs/ tshogs la bstod/ gang 'dul tshul gyi/ zhes pa nas/ lha'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ / zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pas bar gyi 'phrin las bcol/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa'i 'dod/ < mjug ma rnyed lags/ > mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 342 -- PAGE 341 -- PAGE 340 -
